tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-15↗ prob:complex-projective-space-curvature Suppose $(M, g)$ is a 3-dimensional Riemannian manifold that is homogeneous and isotropic. Show that $g$ has constant sectional curvature. Show that the analogous result in dimension 4 is not true. [Hint: See Problem 8-13.] \end{exercise}
